Name: DE-Workloads
Statement:
select 	dw.Oid as WorkloadId,
        dw.DayUtc,
        dw.Workload,
        dwt.Timesheet as TimesheetId,
        usr.Id as UserId,
        usr.Name as [User],
        cli.Oid as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        prj.Oid as ProjectId,
        prj.Number + ' - ' + prj.Number as Project,
        job.Oid as JobId,
        job.NameAndExternalId as Job
from	DailyWorkload dw
            left join DailyWorkloadTimesheet dwt on dwt.DailyWorkload = dw.Oid
            join AssignmentType ast on ast.Oid = dw.Team
            join UserLookup usr on usr.Id = dw.[User]
            join Deliverable job on job.Oid = dw.DocumentOid
            join Project prj on prj.Oid = job.Project
            join CommercialClient cli on cli.Oid = job.Client
where	dw.DocumentTypeName = 'Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Deliverable' and 
        dw.GCRecord is null
